operations.title: For a finite-group quotient, power operations commute with Mackey legs exactly when every fiberwise twisted norm is bijective
operations.statement: For q:G->H and n>=1, coefficient fiber sum commutes with n-th power pullback iff P_n:q^-1(h)->q^-1(h^n) is bijective for every h; equivalently each twisted norm N_{g,n}:ker(q)->ker(q) is bijective. The same multiset criterion governs basis-level fiber lift.
operations.scope: Finite groups and algebraic coefficient-function/group-basis correspondence only; no physical relative-chain transfer.

operations.title: Smallest hostile S3 to C2 power-map test
operations.protocol: Exhaust quotient fibers for n=1..6 and compare S3->C2 against abelian C6->C2 with the same kernel and quotient orders.
operations.falsifier: S3->C2 commutes at n=2 or C6->C2 fails at n=2.

operations.title: Nonabelian twisted-norm Mackey gate research packet

operations.outcome: pass: S3->C2 fails at n=2 while C6->C2 passes; 432 exact coefficient-value checks across 12 cases
